name: io.github.wani-ham/video-to-context
title: Video to Context
description: Turn short videos into timestamped text for LLMs: speech, on-screen text, and visual context.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Claude API key for visual analysis.

environmentVariables.name: VISION_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint, such as Ollama or Gemini.

environmentVariables.name: VISION_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: VISION_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Vision model name. Required with VISION_BASE_URL.

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_TEXT_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Optional folders the server may read local videos from.
